title: Linear Algebra: Vectors and Maps
description: Move vectors, reshape a plane and fit noisy measurements. Build up to eigenvectors and singular value decomposition.
audience: An adult comfortable with signed arithmetic, simple equations and coordinate graphs. Work with real vectors and small matrices through rectangular SVD.
